title: Add validated native DOS standard-stream callbacks
description: The Python compatibility host implements DOS AH=3Fh read and AH=40h write over virtual handles, but runtime/gw_dos_services.c currently handles only DOS version/install checks plus DPMI memory. Add an opt-in native stdio handle layer for injected host stream callbacks on handles 0, 1, and 2. Validate DS:DX guest ranges before host callbacks, preserve short-read/EOF/write counts and DOS carry/error semantics, and keep unconfigured services fail-closed. Do not add file-open/path behavior in this task; WORK1 currently owns the native -k access-violation investigation.
acceptance: Native DOS AH=3Fh reads from an explicitly configured handle into a validated DS:DX range and returns AX=count/CF clear
Native DOS AH=40h writes a validated DS:DX range through the configured callback and returns AX=count/CF clear
EOF, short reads, invalid/unconfigured handles, callback errors, and invalid guest ranges have explicit tested behavior
Unconfigured AH=3Fh/AH=40h remain trapped rather than reporting fabricated success
Existing native DOS/DPMI callback and Python DOS filesystem suites pass
